messages.text: Car clicks repeatedly when turning key in the morning, dashboard lights flicker.
Hi! That classic rapid clicking with flickering dash lights indicates low battery voltage or corroded terminals rather than a starter motor failure. Have you tested terminal tightness?
High-pitched squeal when braking at low speed in city traffic.
Hi! Low speed squeal is often caused by brake pad wear indicator tabs or glazed friction material. Book an inspection before rotor scoring occurs.
